name: fd
description: Fast file finder. Debian names the command fdfind; fd is linked to it.

verified.notes: Built by ezbx build from the Debian snapshot of the box's base image (20261104T212339Z) and used as the agent user with every capability dropped, no-new-privileges and no network: fd-find 8.6.0-3. fd (linked to fdfind) and fdfind found a file by extension. Pi finds it as fdfind and doesn't download its own.
